title: Beings at Mount Zeil let Pat Price know they saw him, and it scared him

tellings.quote: when Pat Price did that one, they let him know that they knew he was there and that scared him.

plain: A former US Army sergeant, Lyn Buchanan, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about Pat Price, a man who, like Buchanan, was said to be able to look at distant places with his mind, and his session targeting Mount Zeil in Australia. Buchanan says that when Price did it, the beings there let him know they knew he was watching, and that scared him. If true, it would mean whatever is at that mountain can sense being observed from afar.
